Design baseline and acquisition specifications: FINAL/Progetto.pdf, pp. 4–5. Efficiency plot is a comparative detector absorption calculation, not a measured qualification result. CZT fabrication and characterization remain project activities.

The plotted pulse-selection example is prior detector-analysis experience (BEGe/VIP context), not proof that the PRISM CZT already meets its targets. CZT and BEGe references are retained from the original presentation. Qualify efficiency, energy response, gain equalization, linearity, rate dependence, dead time, pile-up and channel uniformity on the multichannel detector. Targets: FINAL/Progetto.pdf, ER2 and MS2. The ≤2% detector resolution at Ag Kα must not be confused with the ≤10 eV incident-beam bandwidth.

Source: FINAL/Progetto.pdf, O3/ER3, methodology and WP4/MS4. Ag K-edge ≈25.5 keV; fluorescence Ag Kα ≈22.2 keV. Compare metallic foil and two Ag(I) compounds with different coordination. These are planned measurements, not existing PRISM spectra. In the thin/dilute limit, corrected If/I0 is proportional to absorption. For thick/concentrated samples assess self-absorption explicitly. Quantify acquisition time and accessible operating domain; do not claim an unvalidated one-hour performance. Reference dataset M21, realistic-sample demonstration M24.
